summary: The release workflow's publish steps (release-publish-web-embed and release-publish-edge) no longer fail the whole run on one GitHub 5xx or timeout. They retry it with backoff (10, 30 and 90 seconds), and stay idempotent. A call that GitHub answered with a 504 after it did the work, such as a create that made the release, counts as done instead of failing on "already exists". A failed read is retried rather than taken for "no release". The web embed is published by scripts/release-publish-embed: a draft a failed attempt left is continued by uploading only the files it lacks, an upload GitHub never finished is removed and sent again, and a published embed is still never replaced (no --clobber). Any other error still fails at once. Fixes #4606.

schema.detail: No table, file or schema change.

rules.detail: No checkpoint, retention or digest change.

compatibility.detail: Release workflow and scripts only; no product binary, claim or wire change.

recovery.detail: Rolling back restores the fail-on-first-error publish steps.
